titulo_es: Need identity and ask which one

passa.en: whether or not you are passing through

texto: **Stesso/a/i/e** means «same / a / as». It is usually placed between the article and the name: **Abitiamo nella stessa strada** (we live on the same street); **Abbiamo gli stessi gusti** (we have the same tastes). Positioned to the pronoun or subject brings emphasis: **L'ho fatto io stesso** (I did it myself).

**Quale** (which / what) is used to choose between options from a set: **Quale autobus va in centro?** (which bus goes to the center?); **Qual è la tua decisione?** (what is your decision?). Its plural is **quali**: **Quali libri preferisci?** (which books do you prefer?).

frases.en: Do you still live in Rome, Matteo?

frases.it: Sì! Anzi, abitiamo nella stessa strada dove vivevi tu l'anno scorso.
frases.es: ¡Sí! De hecho, vivimos en la misma calle donde vivías tú el año pasado.
frases.en: Yes! In fact, we live on the same street where you lived last year.

frases.it: Che bella coincidenza! E quale autobus prendi per andare al lavoro?
frases.es: ¡Qué buena coincidencia! ¿Y qué autobús coges para ir al trabajo?
frases.en: What a good coincidence! And what bus do you take to go to work?

frases.it: Prendo il ventisette: passa ogni dieci minuti davanti a casa mia.
frases.es: Cojo el veintisiete: pasa cada diez minutos delante de mi casa.
frases.en: I take the 27: spend every ten minutes in front of my house.

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «We live on the same street.» in Italian?

opciones.explicacion: «Stessa» matches feminine singular with the «strada» noun.
«Strada» is of the genus feminine: it does not support «stesso».
Mix the plural number in the adjective and singular in the name.

bloques.pregunta: What is the right interrogative way to ask for a specific bus between several?

opciones.explicacion: «Quale» is the cross-cutting adjective of selection for singular nouns.
«Chi» applies only to people («who»), not to vehicles or things.

opciones.texto: Che cosa autobus va in centro?
opciones.explicacion: «Che cosa» works as a neutral pronoun and does not determine a common noun in this way.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the right form for «school».
bloques.frase: Abbiamo frequentato la ___ scuola da ragazzi.

bloques.pregunta: What information does the interlocutor request?
bloques.frase: Quali libri hai scelto per il corso universitario?

opciones.texto: What specific book titles the student has selected.
opciones.explicacion: «Quali» asks to choose or specify specific elements of a plural group.

opciones.texto: How many books you still have to buy this year.
opciones.explicacion: That would be a question with «quanti libri».

opciones.texto: For what reason he decided to pursue these higher studies.

bloques.pregunta: What does the prayer describe about the relationship of both?
bloques.frase: Io e Marco abbiamo gli stessi amici e le stesse passioni.

opciones.texto: They match the group of friends and their personal hobbies.
opciones.explicacion: «Gli stessi» and «le stesse» mark identity or community of elements between two parties.

opciones.texto: They have circles of completely opposite and distant friends.
opciones.explicacion: He states otherwise: they share the same friends.

opciones.texto: They have not been known personally since the school stage.

bloques.frase: Quale treno parte prima per Bologna
bloques.traduccion: What train leaves for Bologna before?

bloques.pregunta: How do you ask in plural «What are your projects?»?

opciones.explicacion: «Quale» does not match the verb or the plural subject.
«Chi» asks only for the identity of people.

intro: Learn to express identity and match with «stesso» and to ask selective questions with «quale».
